facts.fact: 写作时点 2020 年 9 月中：华盛顿、俄勒冈、加州大规模野火（气候科学家视为 climate change 的 hands-down 证明，怀疑者仍疑 human-caused 与程度）；六个月前 George Floyd 之死激燃 BLM 运动（终结针对黑人的警察暴力等），但在部分地区、社交媒体与闭门场合遭 counterclaims——all lives matter；疫情显示专家与常人意见分歧（5-6 月公共讨论=公共卫生 vs 经济福祉；conservatives 催重开经济、progressives 优先公共卫生、libertarians 视州长封店令为侵犯个人自由）
我们的无根性（groundlessness）——MacIntyre《After Virtue》（道德哲学+社会学+哲学史杰作）精到揭出；出版 40 年变化不大；他从三个看似寻常的道德分歧（战争、堕胎、政治哲学）入手：现代道德分歧 at once interminable and shrill；其假设=这种无尽与刺耳源于一种全文化范围的、难治的道德 incoherence

梦的类比：陌生又熟悉的风景、不感为家、直觉不知 home 是什么在哪怎么着；低头见脚下无地、漂浮游荡多久？无法 get bearings 也不知 get bearings 何意；Am I losing it?——不 horror 不 terror 而是 less or other；醒来梦醒无别：no firm ground/no home/no sense of direction——You're not alone

第一 meta-crisis=对 groundlessness 的知识；宗教改革以来伦理生活碎裂飞散（splintering and proliferating）→ Brad Gregory《The Unintended Reformation》谓之 hyperpluralism；节食之爆炸为例（omnivorous 到 breatharian 十五种）；共享的 good 之观念日益 opaque → surrogate conceptions 补位（hedonism/careerism/possessive insular love/secular spirituality）；两图并置=fetishizing human agency 的 hyperpluralism 配 derogated substitutes of eudaimonia——两者共同遮蔽 sorely missing 的 shared vision of the good；MacIntyre 引文：every activity/enquiry/practice aims at some good
meta-crisis=我们无法知道该以何为基础生活——自己的、尤其是作为 we 的；只在 metacognitive awareness（元认知觉知）到这 long-standing groundlessness 时才 arise

第二 meta-crisis=对 homelessness 的知识；现代-后现代世界观三大主导学说：physicalism（一切皆物理）、humanism（唯以人为中心的关切要紧）、secularism（无永恒、唯感官经验的 temporal 世界存在）；拥抱此图景的 secular monks 如 Twitter 的 Jack Dorsey；存在论后果：time is scarce → time famine；death anxiety（除非 delusion or forgetfulness）；nihilism all-pervasive（malaise——pointlessness/meaninglessness/helplessness）；Mastropietro & Vervaeke 的 meaning crisis 症状（deaths of despair/loss of communitas/rise of addiction/idolatries of the sacred）；picture too flat——无法探索 Parmenides 的 underworld、Plotinus 的 ascent to the One 等前祛魅冥想宇宙论的维度；feeling stuck/closed in/not catching a full breath/restless；Taylor 的 immanent frame → homeless——at home neither in the world nor in their own skin

两 aspect 互相强化：无 good 之把捉 → 难以 immediate contact the real；无 real 之在场感 → 无法相对 good 定向；如忘却precious things just beyond recollection——Socratic understanding（raw as it is real）是谦卑的开端：把自己完全交给对 ultimate things 的沉思与 living, vibrating wisdom

提案两重：contemplate ultimate things；embark on the path of living wisdom；现代人问 why care——这问题本身就是 nihilism 的表达：现代文化 exudes carelessness——groundless homeless 太久故未学会 care deeply；To care deeply（Socrates 在《申辩》所示）=愿意为真正值得在乎者而死；Living wisdom=caring deeply about contemplated ultimate things with such depth, earnestness, devotion——one's very being 成为 radiant expression、care for all beings 的 very vibration

Contemplation 定义：heart- and mind-open inquiry into the most basic matters of existence；强调问者 not merely questioning some object out there 而是 also implicating himself in the question；此合成（matters of ultimate concern + what matters to, while implicating, me）= the existential；故 contemplation existential through and through、requires our entire being；Rinzai Zen：exhaustively 探问生死大事=把全部自己倒进 koan（life-enigma）——koan 之底即 one's very being 之底

Living wisdom 定义：virtuous conduct flowing directly from the deepest and fullest contemplative understanding of the good and the real；wise 者 perceptive/thoughtful/emotionally attuned/considerate/graceful/whole；若 living wisdom（在心中 joins together the good and the real）都不 matter，什么还 matter？
